name: ENS160 air quality sensor (eCO2/TVOC/AQI)
description: ScioSense digital metal-oxide multi-gas sensor that reports equivalent CO2 (400–65,000 ppm), TVOC (0–65,000 ppb) and the UBA air quality index (1–5) over I2C, with on-chip algorithms. The chip runs on 1.8 V; the breakout adds 1.8 V/3.3 V regulators and level shifting for 3–5 V. Sold as: Adafruit ENS160 MOX Gas Sensor breakout (product 5606; 8-pin: VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCK (= SCL), SDO, SDI (= SDA), CS, INT), I2C address 0x53 (0x52 with SDO tied to GND).
eli5: Sniffs the air and tells your board how stuffy or polluted it is, as a CO2-like number, a VOC number and a 1-to-5 score.

pins.name: VIN
pins.description: Supply, 3–5 V (on-board regulators make 1.8 V and 3.3 V)

pins.name: 3Vo
pins.description: 3.3 V output of the on-board regulator (up to 100 mA); not a supply input, leave unconnected

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock, printed SCK on the board (SPI clock); level shifted, 10 kΩ pull-up on the board

pins.name: SDO
pins.description: I2C address select (SPI MISO): pulled high on the board = 0x53, tie to GND for 0x52

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data, printed SDI on the board (SPI data in); level shifted, 10 kΩ pull-up on the board

pins.name: CS
pins.description: SPI chip select; pulled high on the board, which selects I2C. Leave unconnected for I2C

pins.name: INT
pins.description: Interrupt output (configured in CONFIG 0x11), not needed for basic use

supplierQuery: Adafruit ENS160 MOX gas sensor breakout eCO2 TVOC AQI I2C
buildNotes: Check PART_ID (registers 0x00–0x01, little endian) reads 0x0160, then write OPMODE 0x10 = 0x02 (STANDARD) to start gas sensing; the chip powers up in IDLE and reports nothing until then.
Poll DEVICE_STATUS 0x20 for NEWDAT (bit 1), then read 5 bytes from 0x21: AQI (bits 2:0), TVOC ppb (LSB, MSB), eCO2 ppm (LSB, MSB). New results arrive once a second.
Validity flag (DEVICE_STATUS bits 3:2): 1 = warm-up (about 3 minutes after every power-on), 2 = initial start-up (first hour of the sensor's life). Readings before then are not reliable.
For better accuracy write the ambient temperature to TEMP_IN 0x13 as (°C + 273.15) × 64 and humidity to RH_IN 0x15 as %RH × 512, LSB first.
The heater draws about 29 mA (79 mA peaks): power VIN from the 3V3 or 5 V rail, not from a GPIO.
Leave CS unconnected (pulled high on the board) so the chip stays in I2C mode.

driver.code:
# ENS160 digital metal-oxide multi-gas sensor (ScioSense), MicroPython driver.
# Register map, formats and operating modes from the ScioSense ENS160 datasheet v1.3.
# All multi-byte registers are little endian (LSB at the lower address).
import time

_PART_ID = 0x00        # 2 bytes, reads 0x0160 (0x60, 0x01)
_OPMODE = 0x10         # 0x00 deep sleep, 0x01 idle, 0x02 standard, 0xF0 reset
_CONFIG = 0x11
_COMMAND = 0x12
_TEMP_IN = 0x13        # 2 bytes: (T[°C] + 273.15) * 64
_RH_IN = 0x15          # 2 bytes: RH[%] * 512
_DEVICE_STATUS = 0x20  # bit7 STATAS, bit6 STATER, bits3:2 validity, bit1 NEWDAT, bit0 NEWGPR
_DATA_AQI = 0x21       # bits 2:0 = AQI-UBA 1..5, then TVOC (0x22, ppb) and eCO2 (0x24, ppm)

MODE_DEEP_SLEEP = 0x00
MODE_IDLE = 0x01
MODE_STANDARD = 0x02
_MODE_RESET = 0xF0

VALIDITY = ('normal', 'warm-up', 'initial start-up', 'invalid')


class ENS160:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x53):
        """addr 0x53 with ADDR/SDO high (Adafruit default), 0x52 with it tied to GND."""
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        self.validity = 3
        pid = self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, _PART_ID, 2)
        if pid[0] | (pid[1] << 8) != 0x0160:
            raise OSError('ENS160 not found (PART_ID 0x%04X)' % (pid[0] | (pid[1] << 8)))
        self._mode(_MODE_RESET)
        time.sleep_ms(10)
        self._mode(MODE_IDLE)
        time.sleep_ms(10)
        self._mode(MODE_STANDARD)
        time.sleep_ms(50)

    def _mode(self, m):
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, _OPMODE, bytes([m]))

    def sleep(self):
        """Deep sleep (about 10 µA); call wake() to resume gas sensing."""
        self._mode(MODE_DEEP_SLEEP)

    def wake(self):
        self._mode(MODE_STANDARD)
        time.sleep_ms(50)

    def set_compensation(self, temp_c, rh):
        """Tell the sensor the ambient temperature (°C) and humidity (%) for better accuracy."""
        t = int((temp_c + 273.15) * 64 + 0.5) & 0xFFFF
        h = int(rh * 512 + 0.5) & 0xFFFF
        # LSB first: the chip takes the new value when the MSB is written.
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, _TEMP_IN, bytes([t & 0xFF, t >> 8, h & 0xFF, h >> 8]))

    def status(self):
        return self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, _DEVICE_STATUS, 1)[0]

    def read(self, timeout_ms=3000):
        """Wait for new data (one result per second in standard mode) and return
        (AQI-UBA 1-5, TVOC in ppb, eCO2 in ppm). self.validity is set from the status:
        0 normal, 1 warm-up (first 3 min), 2 initial start-up (first hour ever), 3 invalid."""
        t0 = time.ticks_ms()
        while True:
            st = self.status()
            if st & 0x40:
                raise OSError('ENS160 error flag (STATER) set')
            if st & 0x02:
                break
            if time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), t0) > timeout_ms:
                raise OSError('ENS160: no new data (is it in standard mode?)')
            time.sleep_ms(50)
        self.validity = (st >> 2) & 0x03
        d = self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, _DATA_AQI, 5)
        aqi = d[0] & 0x07
        tvoc = d[1] | (d[2] << 8)
        eco2 = d[3] | (d[4] << 8)
        return aqi, tvoc, eco2

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from ens160 import ENS160

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
sensor = ENS160(i2c)
while True:
    aqi, tvoc, eco2 = sensor.read()
    print('AQI=%d TVOC=%dppb eCO2=%dppm' % (aqi, tvoc, eco2))
    time.sleep(1)
